positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Frontend SME and system architect for a multi-region platform serving 100K+ daily active users across 10,000+ retail locations (US & Canada)
- Supported high-throughput workflows generating millions of backend requests per day, driven by multi-service fan-out and data-intensive user sessions
- Achieved <100ms P99 latency across critical workflows by designing a multi-layer caching strategy (edge/service + microservice Redis)
- Partnered with backend teams to design GraphQL APIs, significantly reducing over-fetching and improving client performance across distributed services
- Built cross-platform messaging system enabling single-source content authoring across web and mobile, reducing duplication and ensuring consistent rendering
- Implemented structured rich-text validation (n-ary preorder traversal) to normalize markup and prevent invalid states across clients
- Designed color-coded “stoplight” UX system for rapid operational visibility, later adopted across multiple product surfaces within the organization
- Led MVP for micro-frontend platform (Module Federation + Single-SPA), enabling independent deployment of applications and reducing cross-team release coupling

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led modernization of enterprise platforms including Shoppers Critique International (280K+ users), delivering full-stack transformations (Angular frontend + ASP → C# MVC .NET backend) 
- Supported systems processing for RiskMD - 150K+ workers’ compensation claims and managing $250B+ in payroll data
- Optimized database performance through query tuning, indexing, and schema normalization, reducing query latency from seconds to milliseconds
- Improved data accuracy and reliability by identifying inconsistencies in upstream data and implementing automated validation and correction pipelines
- Architected and built data ingestion pipelines using SSIS, processing structured and semi-structured data (CSV, Excel, XML) into normalized relational models
- Designed scalable ingestion workflows using ForEach loop containers and automated file processing, enabling seamless handling of high-volume supplier data feeds
- Implemented data cleansing and transformation logic to standardize inconsistent incoming data, improving data quality and reducing downstream rework
- Built fault-tolerant pipelines with error flow redirection and logging, ensuring partial failures did not disrupt full ingestion workflows
- Automated ingestion and processing using SQL Server Agent, eliminating manual data entry workflows and significantly reducing operational overhead
- Architected and delivered applications across multiple stacks:
Java (Spring Boot, JHipster)
C# MVC (.NET) + Angular
React + React Native
iOS (Swift)
- Led full-stack development across diverse client engagements, owning system design, implementation, and delivery across web and mobile platforms
positions.insights: Computer Science, Software Design and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Full stack engineer on a real-time messaging platform serving 14,000+ customers, facilitating millions of conversations across web and mobile clients (24/7)
- Built and integrated SignalR-based real-time communication system, enabling low-latency bidirectional messaging across distributed clients
- Designed and contributed to a scalable messaging architecture using RabbitMQ, decoupling real-time processing from persistence and improving system resilience under high load
- Leveraged RavenDB for high-throughput operational workloads, enabling fast reads/writes for real-time messaging flows
- Implemented asynchronous data pipeline from RavenDB → MySQL, ensuring durable, long-term storage and consistency without impacting real-time performance
- Developed modular frontend architecture using Durandal, supporting scalable UI composition in a legacy SPA system
- Developed and maintained Android application, extending platform capabilities to mobile-native environments
- Designed and operated multi-region CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity + AppVeyor + Octopus Deploy), enabling reliable deployments for a 24/7 high-availability system
- Improved system reliability and performance across high-volume, real-time messaging workloads

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
-  Designed, implemented, and tested features for the company’s largest client using MVC3, Knockout, and Sql Server 2008.
-  Maintained commercial sites using PHP content management systems such as Wordpress, Joomla, and Drupal.
-  Helped develop internal and public facing API's for large scale applications using the ASP.NET Web API framework.
-  Maintained multiple C# .NET desktop applications for a client’s internal applications.
-  Used multiple cloud-based APIs to extend web application usability and features such as: Google Maps, Google Charts, Amazon Web Services, Twilio, and Tropo.
-  Used SVN and Git to manage application source code.
